text:
The response correctly identifies the simplified flow “DNA makes RNA makes protein” and correctly credits Francis Crick with naming the central dogma. However, it does not explicitly name the key processes involved—replication, transcription, and translation—which was a central part of the question. It also includes some imprecise statements, such as calling proteins “the building blocks” rather than noting that amino acids are the building blocks of proteins. Overall, it is partially helpful but lacks important detail and accuracy.

Rating: [[5]]
